answer: Price entry by trust-graph isolation. Each identity is scored by how many independent trust paths link it to established peers; a fresh cluster with none is an oasis - visible but economically unreachable. Earnings require crossing trust edges, so a gale of registrations collects nothing until real peers route value to it, one edge per identity, no batching. Trusted status is a summit each fake node climbs alone, aging out and gathering distinct counterparties. Marginal cost rises linearly with n; honest agents pay once. Unconnected clusters earn zero.
